description:
Title: Internship

You can enter a topic that interests you, and how much money you want.
You can also enter experience and hobbies.
Several offers will arrive (at arbitrary points in time).
You can accept or deny offers.
As soon as an offer is accepted, all other offers become invalid.
You have to write at least 3 status updates about your internship (every week).
The company has to write 3 status updates about you.
After the internship is finished you can recommend the company to a list of friends (via twitter).
Separate tweets are sent in parallel.
generated_bpmn_xml:
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<bpmn:definitions xmlns:bpmn="http://www.omg.org/spec/BPMN/20100524/MODEL"
                  xmlns:xsi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance"
                  targetNamespace="http://example.com/bpmn/internship">
  <bpmn:message id="Message_Offer" name="Internship offer"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Message_Acceptance" name="Offer acceptance"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Message_Tweet" name="Recommendation tweet"/>

  <bpmn:collaboration id="Collaboration_Internship">
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_Applicant" name="Applicant" processRef="Process_Applicant"/>
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_Company" name="Company" processRef="Process_Company"/>
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_Twitter" name="Twitter"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_Offers" name="Offers" sourceRef="Task_SendOffers" targetRef="Task_ReceiveOffer" messageRef="Message_Offer"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_Acceptance" name="Acceptance" sourceRef="Task_AcceptOffer" targetRef="Task_ReceiveAcceptance" messageRef="Message_Acceptance"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_Tweets" name="Tweets" sourceRef="Task_SendTweets" targetRef="Participant_Twitter" messageRef="Message_Tweet"/>
  </bpmn:collaboration>

  <bpmn:process id="Process_Applicant" name="Internship" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:startEvent id="Start_Applicant" name="Begin internship search"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_EnterTopicAndMoney" name="Enter topic of interest and desired amount"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_OptionalDetails" name="Add experience and hobbies?"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_EnterExperienceAndHobbies" name="Enter experience and hobbies"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_OptionalDetailsMerge" name="Continue"/>
    <bpmn:receiveTask id="Task_ReceiveOffer" name="Receive an offer" messageRef="Message_Offer"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_OfferDecision" name="Accept or deny offer?"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_DenyOffer" name="Deny offer"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_AcceptOffer" name="Accept offer" messageRef="Message_Acceptance"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_InvalidateOtherOffers" name="Invalidate all other offers"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_WeeklyUpdates" name="Write at least 3 internship status updates every week"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_InternshipStatus" name="Has the internship finished?" default="Flow_ContinueWeek"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_RecommendCompany" name="Recommend company to friends via Twitter"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_SendTweets" name="Send a separate tweet to each friend in parallel" messageRef="Message_Tweet">
      <bpmn:multiInstanceLoopCharacteristics isSequential="false">
        <bpmn:loopCardinality xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">numberOfFriends</bpmn:loopCardinality>
      </bpmn:multiInstanceLoopCharacteristics>
    </bpmn:sendTask>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="End_Applicant" name="Recommendations sent"/>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_A1" sourceRef="Start_Applicant" targetRef="Task_EnterTopicAndMoney"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_A2" sourceRef="Task_EnterTopicAndMoney" targetRef="Gateway_OptionalDetails"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_A3" sourceRef="Gateway_OptionalDetails" targetRef="Task_EnterExperienceAndHobbies">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">addExperienceAndHobbies</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_A4" sourceRef="Gateway_OptionalDetails" targetRef="Gateway_OptionalDetailsMerge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_A5" sourceRef="Task_EnterExperienceAndHobbies" targetRef="Gateway_OptionalDetailsMerge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_A6" sourceRef="Gateway_OptionalDetailsMerge" targetRef="Task_ReceiveOffer"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_A7" sourceRef="Task_ReceiveOffer" targetRef="Gateway_OfferDecision"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_A8" sourceRef="Gateway_OfferDecision" targetRef="Task_AcceptOffer">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">acceptOffer</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_A9" sourceRef="Gateway_OfferDecision" targetRef="Task_DenyOffer"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_A10" sourceRef="Task_DenyOffer" targetRef="Task_ReceiveOffer"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_A11" sourceRef="Task_AcceptOffer" targetRef="Task_InvalidateOtherOffers"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_A12" sourceRef="Task_InvalidateOtherOffers" targetRef="Task_WeeklyUpdates"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_A13" sourceRef="Task_WeeklyUpdates" targetRef="Gateway_InternshipStatus"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_ContinueWeek" sourceRef="Gateway_InternshipStatus" targetRef="Task_WeeklyUpdates"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_InternshipFinished" sourceRef="Gateway_InternshipStatus" targetRef="Task_RecommendCompany">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">internshipFinished</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_A14" sourceRef="Task_RecommendCompany" targetRef="Task_SendTweets"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_A15" sourceRef="Task_SendTweets" targetRef="End_Applicant"/>
  </bpmn:process>

  <bpmn:process id="Process_Company" name="Company internship activities" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:startEvent id="Start_Company" name="Begin offer process"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_SendOffers" name="Send several internship offers" messageRef="Message_Offer"/>
    <bpmn:receiveTask id="Task_ReceiveAcceptance" name="Receive offer acceptance" messageRef="Message_Acceptance"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_WriteCompanyUpdates" name="Write 3 status updates about the applicant"/>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="End_Company" name="Status updates written"/>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_C1" sourceRef="Start_Company" targetRef="Task_SendOffers"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_C2" sourceRef="Task_SendOffers" targetRef="Task_ReceiveAcceptance"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_C3" sourceRef="Task_ReceiveAcceptance" targetRef="Task_WriteCompanyUpdates"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_C4" sourceRef="Task_WriteCompanyUpdates" targetRef="End_Company"/>
  </bpmn:process>
</bpmn:definitions>
